name: Zapier
whatYouLose: Thousands of maintained integrations with OAuth already approved
Reliability: retries, replay, error alerts and a task history
A no-code editor non-engineers on your team can use
prompt:
Build a code-first automation runner, a Zapier replacement for developers.

Stack: Node + TypeScript, SQLite job queue, a small web UI.
Features:
- Workflows are TS files in /workflows exporting {trigger, steps}. Triggers: webhook URL, cron schedule, poll an RSS/JSON endpoint, IMAP new email.
- Steps are plain async functions with a typed context; built-in helpers for HTTP, Slack, Discord, email (SMTP), Google Sheets (service account), OpenAI-compatible LLM calls.
- Every run is persisted with inputs/outputs per step; failed steps retry with exponential backoff; replay any run from the UI.
- UI: workflow list, run history, logs, enable/disable toggle; secrets in .env.
Done when: a webhook-triggered workflow posts to Discord and a cron workflow appends a row to a Google Sheet.
notes: For developers, code-first automation is better than Zapier. For the marketing team, it is not a replacement.
